newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong raises no eyebrows with '96 Q4 growth.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong raises no eyebrows with '96 Q4 growth.

text.p: Hong Kong's economy grew 5.5 percent in the fourth quarter last year, meeting expectations and paving the way for a steady economic performance throughout 1997, this sensitive year of transition to Chinese rule.
"It was really no surprise," said Kevin Chan, economist at Salomon Brothers in Hong Kong. "It was in line with expectations."

The Hong Kong government said on Monday that gross domestic product grew 5.5 percent in real terms in the fourth quarter last year, following increases of 3.5 percent, 4.7 percent and five percent in the first three quarters respectively.
Minor revisions in the estimates for the prior three quarters of 1996 created no change in the government's overall estimate of 4.7-percent economic growth throughout 1996.
Hong Kong's economy is expected to grow 5.5 percent in 1997, confirming economic recovery in the year that Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule. China takes back Hong Kong on July 1.
The figures released on Monday confirmed an improving economic trend, including a year-on-year increase of 6.4 percent in private consumption expenditure in the fourth quarter.

In external trade, re-exports -- goods shipped through Hong Kong for processing elsewhere before being returned to Hong Kong for export -- grew eight percent in real terms in the fourth quarter, while domestic exports declined by 7.2 percent.
Overall, total exports increased by 5.4 percent.
Imports of goods grew by 6.5 percent in the fourth quarter last year while exports of services rose 5.6 percent. Growth in imports of services was lower, at 2.6 percent.
The implicit price deflator of the GDP, as a broad measure of inflation in the economy, rose by 6.2 percent in the fourth quarter in real terms.
For 1996 as a whole, the deflator rose by 5.4 percent, which compared favourably with the government's earlier estimate of 6.7 percent.
Inflation is forecast at seven percent in 1997.
